title: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
abstract: Formalizes the spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators on a Hilbert space: such an operator admits a Hilbert basis of eigenvectors. The development passes from weak compactness of Hilbert closed balls and Rayleigh-quotient extrema to an eigenvector at the operator norm, finiteness of the point spectrum outside any neighbourhood of zero, finite-rank cutoff approximation, and finally the orthogonal decomposition into eigenspaces.

informal.CompactSelfAdjoint.exists_hilbertBasis_h: A compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space admits a Hilbert basis of eigenvectors.
informal.CompactSelfAdjoint.iSup_eigenspace_ortho: The eigenspaces of a compact self-adjoint operator span a dense subspace: the orthogonal complement of the supremum of all eigenspaces is trivial.
informal.CompactSelfAdjoint.exists_hasEigenvector: A compact self-adjoint operator has an eigenvector whose eigenvalue realizes either the supremum or the infimum of its Rayleigh quotient.
informal.CompactSelfAdjoint.exists_unit_norm_eq_o: A compact operator attains its operator norm on the unit sphere of the Hilbert space.
informal.CompactSelfAdjoint.countable_set_hasEige: The set of nonzero eigenvalues of a compact self-adjoint operator is countable.
